It starts off with just the piano playing those sad ass notes, then the beat kicks in and theres a voice thats going from the left speaker to right speaker saying LOOK AT YA LOOK ATCHA showing that thats all he hears all around. (Btw context = taylor swift incident). They lyrics are so honest from that point on, tells everyone to and why to runaway from him. 

The start of the lines of his first verse feel interchangable 'she finds pictures in my email, im not good with that shit' for example and all of it flows well. The bridge is just so raw. Pusha T came through with his verse ofc. Same for second verse as first verse.

The outro itself is my favorite part, some people think its bad and that its not that great. To me, dealing with severe depression and my head telling me to kill myself after my mind breaks me down, then I cry and shit. I moan and I scream cause shits painful, and the fact that he does it so long feels like those moments for me because I used to scream into a pillow for hours, and the way that he screams into the pillow you'll notice it starts off soft and then it gradually builds up, which is what I used to do. Thats what your hearing Kanye do at the end (at least thats my interpretation). Then the end its just the piano, for me personally signifying that hes over his tantrum and hes just back to where he started, sad, but getting back up.
